text.description_html:
Laurey 72826, 7/8 Inch Square Polished Chrome Cosmopolitan Knob

The 7/8 Inch Square Polished Chrome Cosmopolitan Knob has a transitional style that is great for most kitchens. The Polished Chrome is trending in kitchen decor so all you hardware can match: faucets, cabinet hardware, and refrigerator handles. This Square Polished Chrome Cosmopolitan Knob features a square inlay that will add interest to any lightweight door or drawer. The 7/8 Square Cabinet Knob Polished Chrome comes packaged with the mounting hardware.

This cabinet knob is part of the Laurey Cosmopolitan Collection.

Specifications and Features of the Laurey 72826 Polished Chrome Square Cosmopolitan Cabinet Knob:

  • Material: Zinc
  • Finish: Polished Chrome
  • Length: 7/8" square
  • Projection: 3/4"
  • Packaged with 1" long #8-32 screw and 1-1/2" long #8-32 screw.

Available in 4 finishes:
Polished Chrome Oil Rubbed Bronze Champagne Brass Satin Nickel

Sold Individually
